name: Omax Ai 2.0.4 without Play Services
body:
New in this version:

• Custom Omax Ais — pick a specialised assistant from the composer's tools menu.
• Image aspect ratio — choose the shape of generated images before you send.
• More reliable on tablets — the composer now sizes itself correctly alongside the sidebar.
• Fewer crashes — if the web view runs out of memory, Omax Ai now recovers and reloads instead of closing.
• Fixed a navigation issue that could leave you on the wrong screen.

Thanks for using Omax Ai!
